title: Welcome to our new website!
body: We've launched a brand new members-only website for The Hour Club. Here you'll find meeting schedules, announcements, resources, and more. Bookmark this page and check back often for updates.

title: Spring cleanup day — volunteers needed
body: Join us Saturday, April 12th at 9:00 AM for our spring cleanup. We'll be tidying up the clubhouse inside and out. Bring gloves and a good attitude. Coffee and donuts provided. Many hands make light work!

title: New Thursday night Big Book study
body: Starting this month, we've added a Big Book Study meeting every Thursday at 8:00 PM. This is an open meeting and everyone is welcome. Come join the discussion as we work through the Big Book together.
